learning_outcomes.text: By analyzing the design and functional requirements (geometry, tolerances, material properties, etc.) of a machine part, the appropriate manufacturing method can be selected according to technical and economic criteria.
It can analyze casting and powder metallurgy processes by comparing them in terms of solidification and sintering kinetics, microstructure development, and production defects.
It can compare welding, soldering, and bonding methods in terms of their working principles, connection characteristics, and quality requirements, and select the appropriate joining method.
It can evaluate the effect of process parameters on the final microstructure and mechanical properties based on temperature (hot, warm, cold) and deformation mechanisms in plastic forming methods.
It can compare machining and additive manufacturing methods in terms of surface quality, production cost, material usage, and design requirements, and select the appropriate production method.

syllabus_topics: Classification of manufacturing methods, engineering materials, relationship between material properties and manufacturing method.
Mechanical properties, manufacturability, and manufacturing method selection criteria.
Basic principles of casting, model and mold systems, sand casting.
Die casting, pressure casting, precision casting, casting defects
Basic principles of welding, weldability, gas welding and electric arc welding.
MIG/MAG, TIG, resistance welding, welding defects and quality control.
Wire and pipe drawing, bending, sheet metal forming, deep drawing
Chip formation, cutting tool materials, cutting parameters
Tool wear, tool life, surface roughness, cutting fluids.
Powder production, pressing, sintering, application areas.
Additive manufacturing (FDM, SLA, SLS, etc.) methods, advantages, limitations and applications.
Comparison of different manufacturing methods in terms of technical, economic and quality, method selection, sample engineering applications
bibliography: Materials and processes in manufacturing, DeGARMO, BLACK, KOHSER.
Üretim yöntemleri veİmalat Teknolojileri, M. Aydın, M. Gavas, M. yaşar, Y. Altunpak, Seçkin yayınevi.
